import json
w = []
for i in range(8):
    scopes = []
    for j in range(32):
        scopes.append({"id":"s%02d"%j, "prefix":"2001:db8:%x:%x00::/56"%(i+1, j), "subnets":[k for k in range(8)]})

open('/workspace/tmp/t/work/max.json','w').write(json.dumps(m))
print(len(json.dumps(m)))
EOF
